findings.problem: The spelling description is wrong: dropping the h from photo gives poto, and no o is added because photo already ends in o; the real change is ph becoming f.
findings.fix: trick: FOTO is just photo spelled the Spanish way, with f instead of ph, and it is feminine because it is short for la fotografía.

back.es: the photo, picture (short for la fotografía)
back.example: Will you take a photo of me with my mom?

note: Spain usually says hacer una foto where Latin America says tomar or sacar una foto, but the noun itself is the same, so spain is correctly null.
